home_page.title: Let's build the pools of your dreams
home_page.descrizione: With our daily experience and expertise, we turn the dream of your ideal pool into reality.

rivestimenti_dettagli: Waterproofing the pool is essential to ensure the durability of materials and to prevent environmentally harmful and costly leaks.
Furthermore, when constructing a new pool or performing repairs, the choice of coating is equally important.
Pool coatings are designed to protect and seal the walls and bottom of the pool, ensuring durability and resistance against wear and water chemicals.
costruzioni_dettagli: Dea Piscine constructs in-ground pools with custom-made structures in cast concrete, monoblock, or light materials.
These different processes are all high-end, using various construction techniques.
ristrutturazioni_dettagli: Pool renovation is usually necessary for leaks, cracks, or damaged coatings.
Over time, every pool deteriorates and requires maintenance, offering the opportunity for a restyling.

rivestimenti.title: linings
anteprima: The pool lining is essential for both aesthetics and safety.
It offers a wide range of colors to customize the water and must withstand chemicals and sunlight to preserve the longevity and structural integrity of the pool.
descrizione: Pool linings are essential materials that ensure hygiene and enhance the aesthetics of the pool.
Often made of resin or ceramic, they offer resistance to chemicals and sunlight.
Additionally, a wide range of colors provides numerous options for aesthetic customization, allowing the choice of water color based on external light and the type of lining.
They contribute to creating a safe, durable, and attractive environment for enjoyment and relaxation.

tipologia.title: natural stone
descrizione: Natural stones are commonly used to pave areas surrounding the pool or delineate its edges.
Their primary purpose is to ensure a safe and comfortable surface, reducing the risk of slips and accidents.
In addition, they enhance the overall appearance of the surrounding environment, contributing to its aesthetics and overall functionality of the pool.

tipologia.title: mosaic
descrizione: Pool mosaics combine aesthetics and functionality, offering a wide range of aesthetic and practical benefits.
They can be made with small glass, ceramic, or stone tiles, allowing for unlimited design customization.
Thanks to their resistance to chemical agents and durability over time, they represent a durable and easy-to-maintain choice.
With their timeless beauty, mosaics transform every pool into an oasis of elegance and style.

tipologia.title: polyester resins
descrizione: The modern polyester resin coating offers numerous advantages, including perfect waterproofing and a smooth, easy-to-maintain finish with GelCoat.
Ideal for all pools, it is reliable, durable, and compatible with various water treatments.
Thanks to its elasticity, it adapts to ground movements and prevents cracks, making it the most widespread coating and also suitable for local renovations.

tipologia.title: porcelain stoneware
descrizione: Porcelain stoneware is an extremely durable and non-porous ceramic tile, obtained by pressing and firing finely selected clays at around 1200 degrees Celsius.
Its compactness and impermeability derive from the clay's vitrification, making it highly resistant to water absorption and bending.
Thanks to these characteristics, it is ideal for long-lasting and high-quality flooring and cladding.

bordi.title: edges
anteprima: The outer edge of the pool (border) and the surrounding area must be carefully designed to serve various functions, such as passage zones or relaxation spaces.
Careful selection of materials, such as concrete or natural stone, is crucial to fit users' preferences and ensure both pleasing aesthetics and optimal functionality.
descrizione: The edges of your pool are of fundamental importance both aesthetically and to ensure your and your guests' safety.
We recommend opting for non-slip, frost-resistant, and thermally-insulated materials to ensure a safe environment even when wet.

pavimentazione.title: pavements
anteprima: Pool pavements primarily serve to ensure a safe and comfortable surface around the pool, preventing slips and falls.
Additionally, they contribute to the overall aesthetics of the surrounding area, enhancing the appearance and functionality of the pool environment.
descrizione: Pavements in a pool play an absolutely crucial role in ensuring a safe and rewarding experience while venturing into the water.
They are not just a matter of aesthetic appearance, but represent the cornerstone of the functionality and safety of the entire surrounding environment.

These pavements, in addition to providing a secure base, significantly contribute to the overall beauty of the pool environment. With their refined design and the variety of materials and finishes available, they add a touch of elegance and style to your outdoor space, transforming it into an oasis of tranquility and sophistication.

canalette.title: channels
anteprima: Channels are used in overflow pools to collect water overflowing along the perimeter edge, ensuring an elegant visual appearance and preventing water spillage outside the pool.
descrizione: In overflow pools, water flows to the edge, creating a distinctive and pleasing visual impact.
A channel system is installed along the pool's perimeter to collect excess water overflowing and to direct it evenly, ensuring a constant level.
This design not only offers a more aesthetically pleasing view than traditional pools but also a more refined and comfortable swimming experience.

componenti_homepage: After working together on the design and technical aspects of your pool, it's finally time to focus on the aspect that will truly make your personal oasis unique.

Imagine linings that shimmer in the sunlight, edges that beckon you into the cool water, pavements that welcome your steps, channels that ensure cleanliness, and ladders that make access so convenient.

These are not just aesthetic details, but true pillars of your experience. A careful choice of lining will not only add a touch of elegance but also ensure a long life for your pool, preserving its beauty over time.

Edges, pavements, channels, and ladders are all essential elements that go beyond mere aesthetics. Their strategic arrangement and the quality of materials will contribute to maximizing not only comfort but above all safety during every moment of relaxation and fun.

hero_section.title: Renovations
descrizione: For over ten years, we have been building pools of every size, shape, and style throughout France and Northern Italy: rectangular, oval, round, or custom-made.
Our team of experts will guide you in choosing the structure most suitable for your needs, taking into account the terrain and budget available.
Dea Piscine stands out for its extensive experience in building high-quality pools.

We offer in-ground pools with customized structures in cast concrete, monoblock, lightweight, and much more, all of which are characterized by excellence and built using advanced construction techniques.

modifica_piscina.title: Pool Renovation
descrizione: If you want to give your pool a new look or add features such as a spa, an underwater cover, or a counter-current swimming system, it is necessary to redefine the structure of your pool to integrate these innovations directly into the walls.
We can raise the bottom or change the shape of the pool.
Whether it's too deep, too large, impractical, or simply no longer to your liking, every transformation is possible!
These interventions, both aesthetic and functional, can vary in complexity and scope.
Dea Piscine professionals will be able to offer you advice based on the latest trends, your installation, and your needs.

rinnovo_piscina.title: Pool Renewal
descrizione: Since pools also follow fashion and desire trends, you can renew your pool to keep up with the times.
One of the most common maintenance interventions is the refurbishment of the finishing coating, which often needs updating.

Modifying the access and environment of the pool, such as building a wide staircase or a submerged beach, is a frequent transformation to better integrate it into its context and improve the overall aesthetics.
These interventions help give new life to an existing pool.

restauro_piscina.title: Complete Restoration
descrizione: A complete restoration of a masonry pool includes all aspects of the structure, from the cover, to the edges, and all equipment.
As expert pool builders, we handle every phase of the work: plumbing, waterproofing, masonry, cladding, treatment, and more.

In addition, we offer a wide range of custom coatings and accessories, such as underwater lighting systems, heating systems, energy-saving pumps, and automated covers, to improve both the aesthetics and functionality of your pool.

hero_section.title: Constructions
hero_section.descrizione: We can execute different types of construction, both in the shape of the pool and in the type of material used.

cemento_colato.title: Cast Concrete Structures
descrizione: In-ground pools with masonry structures are the pinnacle of offerings in the pool industry.
Using the poured concrete technique, a slatted formwork is positioned in the ground, reinforced by a scrap metal frame.
Concrete is poured in two stages, first creating the floor and then the walls of the future pool.
This construction method is widely used and renowned for its exceptional durability over time.

cemento_monoblocco.title: Monoblock Cement for Waterproofing
descrizione: This innovative and patented process is based on creating formworks with extremely rigid walls.
A sophisticated system of chains and beams completely surrounds the entire plant.
Concrete, poured all at once to form the monolithic structure, has no joints.
The absence of interruptions in the concrete eliminates any risk of movement or cracking over time.
In addition, a thin galvanized mesh inside the tank prevents the formation of micro-cracks during the concrete pouring process.
This monolithic concrete technique can be adopted for any pool shape.

struttura_leggera.title: Lightweight Structures
descrizione: When the ground on which you want to build your pool cannot support the weight of a solid structure in traditional concrete, there is the solution of the lightweight structure.
Lightweight concrete is suitable for any type of flooring, giving the advantage of being fast and economical.
To cover lightweight structures, materials such as polyester or Gel Coat can be used, which are applied directly.
Alternatively, you can consider using mosaics or tiles, over a first layer of insulation.

calore.title: heat pump
anteprima: To extend the swimming season, consider installing a heat pump.
This device keeps the water temperature constant, allowing optimal comfort year-round.
descrizione: A heat pump acts as a heating system that uses thermal energy from the external environment to heat the pool water.
It works like an air conditioner in reverse, extracting heat from the surrounding air and transferring it to the water through a process of compression and decompression of the refrigerant.
In this way, the heat pump maintains the water temperature constant using only a small amount of electricity to operate the fan and compressor.

nuoto.title: counter-current swimming
anteprima: Counter-current swimming is the perfect choice for convenient home workouts.
With this feature, you can exercise in your personal space, such as your garden or terrace.
descrizione: Counter-current swimming is a system installed in the pool that generates an adjustable water current.
This current allows you to swim in place, simulating swimming in open water or currents.
It can be adjusted in intensity and speed, creating a continuous flow of water.
It's a great way to train in limited spaces, improving endurance and muscle strength, combining relaxation and physical activity.

copertura.title: electric cover
anteprima: Winter pool covers are essential to keep your pool safe from debris, weather, and harmful UV rays, while preventing the growth of bacteria and algae.
descrizione: Swimming is not only a refreshing activity but also a great way to stay fit.
If you're fortunate enough to have a private pool, pool covers from Coperture Piscine can significantly extend the time you can enjoy this activity.
With our covers, you can protect your pool from external elements, allowing you to swim safely even during hot summer days and colder winter months.
Investing in a cover for your pool not only reduces maintenance and extends its lifespan but also allows you to experience the pleasure of swimming all year round, in total comfort and safety.

idromassaggio.title: hot tub
anteprima: Installing a hot tub system in the pool not only adds value to the structure but also offers tangible benefits for physical and mental well-being.
descrizione: The hot tub, thanks to the combination of water and air, can help improve blood circulation, alleviate muscle pain, and reduce stress.
The water pressure on the body can promote muscle relaxation, while the air bubbles can stimulate circulation and relieve tension.
This treatment can be particularly beneficial for reducing chronic pain, improving sleep quality, and promoting an overall sense of well-being.

accessori_homepage: Consider choosing accessories for your pool like selecting ingredients for a perfect recipe.
Each component is important to achieve the desired result and ensure a satisfying experience.
Covers, for example, are like salt, essential to keep your pool in optimal condition, ensuring cleanliness and safety during inactive periods.
Heat pumps and counter-current swimming add that extra touch of comfort.

descrizione: The renovation of swimming pools involves a series of interventions such as replacing the pool surface (tiles or liner), structural repairs, and the application of new technologies aimed at improving the aesthetic appearance and various performances of the pool, including waterproofing.

The latter offers numerous advantages, such as preventing leaks, protecting materials, long-term economic savings, environmental protection, and improving overall performance of the pool, thus ensuring significantly longer durability.
In our case, we perform a pressure test on the water channeling system: a fundamental procedure to verify the integrity of the hydraulic system and detect any water leaks or sealing issues.
During this test, controlled pressure is applied within the hydraulic system, simulating normal operating conditions.

The construction of a swimming pool includes a series of procedures aimed at creating a functional and safe structure for swimming and relaxation such as construction in reinforced concrete, monobloc pool, and much more.

A type of construction known for its elegant design and luxurious appearance is the overflow pool, characterized by a raised edge on one or more sides, allowing water to gently flow over it and fall into a collection channel that surrounds the perimeter of the pool.
The hydraulic part of a pool represents the heart of the pool itself.
It is composed of a series of pipes, pumps, and filters that work together to keep the water clean and in motion.
These components ensure that the water is filtered and circulated to remove dirt and impurities, thus providing a safe and enjoyable pool experience for users.
Pool masonry refers to the construction of the walls and bottom of the pool using construction materials such as reinforced concrete or concrete blocks.
This construction technique involves creating a solid and equally resistant structure.
Pool masonry is a fundamental step in its construction, as it provides the supporting structure on which linings, hydraulic systems, and other components will be installed.
Important note: a pool built with masonry technique is generally considered sturdy and durable over time.
In general, pool repair aims to restore the performance, safety, and appearance of the pool, ensuring that it is a safe and pleasant environment for swimming and relaxation.
In pool repair, various activities are carried out to solve problems or damage that may occur over time.
Various types of repairs include repairing the lining, water leaks, and much more.
